IBEW.text:
**Trampin the IBEW Indoor Locals — Thursday, August 13, 2026**

**LU-481 Indianapolis, IN** is running hot with 34 calls and **$54.75/hr** top scale. Industrial Electric's got 12 hands needed on the Eli Lilly K153 Southside job (6-10s Mon-Sat, new construction), and Ermco is pulling for the Google Data Center Mooresville gig with 5-10s, Saturdays, and double-time OT if you log all hours. This is the rare board where scale actually reflects the grind.

**LU-1426 Grand Forks, ND** sits at 25 calls with **$44.80/hr** base but the real money's in the incentives. Parsons Electric's Polaris Forge Data Center is offering **$100/day non-taxed per diem on weekdays, $150 on weekends, plus an extra $100/day if you hold an ND license**—that's a $50k bump annually if you stick it out on the 6-10s schedule. Drug test and 2 IDs required.

**LU-291 Boise, ID** has **$65.33/hr** at the top but the Micron Idaho play (EC Electric) drops to **$45.33 with $170/day per diem** and a **$20/hr incentive** on a punishing 60-60-50 schedule. META work via VECA holds the higher rate and MOU premium OT.

**LU-430 Racine, WI** and the Microsoft Mount Pleasant build are unified across four contractors at **$62.51/hr**—Gerdes, Pieper, Staff Electric, and Kelso Burnett all need JWs for the same footprint. Board's got 11 calls but tight. Wisconsin license or 2+ years verifiable reciprocal required.

**LU-683 Columbus, OH** shows 25 calls at **$54.50/hr** with the Cologix Data Center push (McGraw Kokosing, ESI) paying **all OT at double time**—that's the sweetener when you're chasing volume hours.

The board-wide story: data centers are eating 40% of the calls nationwide. Pack your ND license if you're heading to the northern plains.

LINEMAN.text:
**Trampin the IBEW Lineman Locals — Thursday, August 13, 2026**

**LU-583 El Paso, TX** is running hot. Summit Line's Project Miner in Santa Teresa, NM is paying **$55/hr** base with **$65/hr for anyone 350+ miles out**, all OT double time — that's real money for transmission work. Rosendin's Meta El Paso gig hits **$40 base + $15 incentive** if you stack 60-hour weeks, also double-time OT. Only 9 calls across a shallow 86-hand book means you move fast here.

**LU-291 Boise, ID** has VECA Electric lighting up the META 3&5 site at **$65.33/hr** with incentive programs and premium OT pay. EC Electric's Micron job pays **$45.33 base + $20/hr** on a PLA with **$170/day per diem** (7 days if eligible) — that's 60/60/50 schedule grit, but the money stacks. Book depth sits around 77 hands against 20 live calls; insider play.

**LU-71 Columbus, OH** — New River Electric is the real volume player here with 40 JL spots in Columbus proper hitting **$125/day per diem**, nights stayed, **$125 bonus on 10-hour days**, 6-10s, CDL required. Another 9 JL calls in Southern Ohio on 4-10s. That's 49 JL calls alone in distro work. Book's 140 deep but moving.

**LU-84 Newnan, GA** — Service Electric's Social Circle work runs **$51.80/hr** (barehand-certified earners) or **$46.80/hr**, **$150/day per diem**, 11-on-3-off for GA Power energized work. That rotating schedule is brutal but the pay clears noise. 28 calls, 94-hand book, real dispatch velocity.

**LU-1426 Grand Forks, ND** is data-center density. Parsons Electric's Polaris Forge site in Harwood is stacking 44 Inside JW slots at **$44.80/hr** plus **$100-$150/day per diem** (incentive rates M-F/weekends), non-taxed. Hunt Electric at the Air Base adds another 10. Light book relative to call count — this one's moving **fast**.

Data-center and transmission backbone work is dominating August; hands are chasing the big infrastructure plays with predictable schedules and per diem depth.

UA.text:
**Trampin the UA Locals — Thursday, August 13, 2026**

**LU-140 Salt Lake City, UT** is the board's heavyweight with 18 calls and 61 hands needed. BCS Mechanical is running dual-track on the Sego Project in West Valley—15 JW pipefitters and 13 JW plumbers both on 4-10s starting Aug 3, full OT available. DSI's QTS data center gig in Eagle Mountain adds 6 more pipefitters at a confirmed **$10.00 OT premium** on mixed 5-8s and 5-10s schedules. Salt Lake's moving serious volume right now.

**LU-290 Portland, OR** sits at 21 open calls but that's misleading—this board's specialized. Charter Mechanical needs 4 orbital welders for Intel Ronler Acres tool install; Apollo wants 2 BIM detailers at foreman scale. These aren't grunt calls; they're ticket-specific and skill-gated. Details are locked up tight at the hall.

**LU-776 Lima, OH** shows **top scale $53.00/hr** across 10 calls with real industrial backbone. Graham's running 4-10s on Cenovus maintenance pipefitting (spotty OT heads-up). Gem's combo-welding fab shop runs 6-10s; Ineos outage work pipefitters will transition from the fab shop into the field. Nooter layers in **$125/day per diem** for fab and refinery work with incentive pay. This local's stacked with process piping infrastructure.

**LU-213 St. John, NB** and **LU-325 Fredericton, NB** are Irving Oil and pulp-and-paper refinery plays—Stuart Olson and CAM contracts, day shifts, GPMA and Industrial agreements locked. Canada's industrial maintenance is heating up.

**LU-525 Las Vegas, NV** is thin (1 call, 12 hands) but the Four Seasons towers job is live—Thursday 7/30 start requires OSHA 10/30 card.

Data center buildouts and refinery turnarounds are pulling hands hard across mountain and plains locals.
